notes: Mirage loader waits until no card shows an absence mark: the Laptop card came up as dashes because the first telemetry frame arrived before the WMI battery reading (maxWaitMs still bounds the wait).
A Mirage strip shows current weather once: the first weather card keeps the current line, later ones (e.g. FPS backup weather) draw the forecast only.
Weather "+ icon" forms keep their icons: the current line shrinks, closes its gap and drops high/low before the forecast icons give way.
